services.name: Day Pass
services.shortDesc: One full day on the floor, no membership needed.
services.longDesc: You get the strength floor, the cardio deck and any group class running that day. A coach walks you through the machines in the first fifteen minutes.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want a Day Pass at Zoom Fitness. The day I want to come is:
services.whoNeeds: Visitors to Vijayawada, and anyone who wants to see the floor before joining.
services.aftercare: Keep the pass receipt. It is adjusted against your joining fee if you sign up the same week.

services.name: Gym Floor Membership
services.shortDesc: Full access to the strength floor and cardio deck.
services.longDesc: Train on your own schedule during open-floor hours. A coach is on the floor at all times to check your form and load. Your programme is written on paper and reviewed every four weeks.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join the Gym Floor Membership at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Anyone training three or more days a week who prefers to work through a plan alone.
services.aftercare: Log your working sets in the card at the desk so the next review has real numbers.

services.name: Personal Training
services.shortDesc: One coach, one plan, twelve sessions a month.
services.longDesc: You train with the same coach every session. Load, rest and technique are decided for you, and every session is recorded so progress is visible on paper rather than by feel.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book Personal Training at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Beginners, people returning after an injury, and anyone stuck at the same weights for months.
services.aftercare: Eat within ninety minutes of the session and keep the rest day your coach marks on the card.

services.name: Small Group Strength
services.shortDesc: Barbell training in a batch of six.
services.longDesc: Squat, press, deadlift and row, coached in a fixed batch of six people. Everyone runs the same session at their own load, so the coach can watch every rep.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join Small Group Strength at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Members who want barbell coaching without paying for one-to-one sessions.
services.aftercare: Rack the bar, wipe the bench and note your top set before you leave the rack.

services.name: Circuit Conditioning
services.shortDesc: Eight stations, forty seconds each, no queueing.
services.longDesc: A coached circuit built from sleds, ropes, kettlebells and the assault bike. The room runs on a clock, so a full session finishes in under an hour.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join Circuit Conditioning at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: People short on time who want the heart rate up without running outdoors.
services.aftercare: Drink 500 ml of water before you leave and stretch your calves at the wall.

services.name: Women's Strength Batch
services.shortDesc: A women-only batch, 7.30 AM on weekdays.
services.longDesc: The floor is reserved for the batch and coached by Sowmya. The plan starts with bodyweight and dumbbells, and moves to the barbell when your technique holds.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join the Women's Strength Batch at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Women who want a reserved floor and a coach who has trained beginners for years.
services.aftercare: Keep the mobility sheet at home and do the two hip drills on your rest days.

services.name: Zumba
services.shortDesc: An hour of choreography in the studio upstairs.
services.longDesc: A full-hour class with music, run in the mirrored studio. No steps are taught in advance, so you can walk into your first class and follow along.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join Zumba at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Members who want cardio that does not feel like a treadmill.
services.aftercare: Change out of wet clothes before you sit in the AC lounge.

services.name: Morning Yoga
services.shortDesc: Breath, mobility and balance before work.
services.longDesc: A 6.30 AM class focused on hips, shoulders and spine. It pairs well with a strength plan and is often prescribed alongside heavy training days.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to join Morning Yoga at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Desk workers with stiff hips and lower-back tightness.
services.aftercare: Carry your own mat if you prefer, or use one of the studio mats and wipe it after.

services.name: 12-Week Fat Loss Program
services.shortDesc: Training, diet and weekly measurement in one fee.
services.longDesc: Three coached sessions a week, a diet plan from Deepthi and a body composition check every Saturday. You get a printed sheet at week six showing what moved and what did not.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want details of the 12-Week Fat Loss Program at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Members with a specific target and a fixed date, such as a wedding or a medical review.
services.aftercare: Weigh yourself on the same morning each week, before food, on the studio scale.

services.name: Diet Consultation
services.shortDesc: A written plan built around what you already eat.
services.longDesc: You sit with Deepthi for forty minutes. She takes your measurements, your usual meal timings and your budget, and gives you a plan on one page.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book a Diet Consultation at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Anyone training regularly whose weight has not moved in eight weeks.
services.aftercare: Photograph your meals for the first week so the review has something to work with.

services.name: Mobility and Recovery
services.shortDesc: Stretching, foam rolling and joint work.
services.longDesc: A guided session for the joints that take load during the week. Useful on the day after a heavy squat or deadlift session.
services.whatsappMessage: Hi, I want to book a Mobility and Recovery session at Zoom Fitness. My name is:
services.whoNeeds: Members with knee, shoulder or lower-back stiffness that shows up during lifts.
services.aftercare: Repeat the two drills your coach marks, at home, on the days you do not train.

team.name: Ravi Teja Bandaru
team.bio: Ravi competed in state-level powerlifting for six years before he started coaching. He writes every barbell programme in the studio on paper and keeps a copy at the desk, because he does not trust an app to remember what your knee did last February.
team.photoAlt: Ravi Teja Bandaru coaching on the strength floor
education: NSCA Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist
Level 1 Powerlifting Coach — Indian Powerlifting Federation

team.name: Sowmya Vaddadi
team.qualification: ACSM Certified Personal Trainer, Pre and Post-Natal Certified
team.bio: Sowmya runs the 7.30 AM women's batch and the Zumba floor. She started with bodyweight classes in a Labbipet apartment block and still begins every new member on the same four movements before anything gets loaded.
team.photoAlt: Sowmya Vaddadi taking the women's strength batch
education: Pre and Post-Natal Exercise Certification — Fit For Birth

team.name: Imran Shaik
team.bio: Imran runs the circuit floor and the 12-week fat loss batches. He keeps the clock on the wall rather than on a phone, so a class that starts at 5.00 PM finishes at 5.45 PM and members can get back to work.
team.photoAlt: Imran Shaik setting up the conditioning circuit
education: First Aid and CPR — St. John Ambulance

team.name: Deepthi Alluri
team.qualification: MSc Nutrition and Dietetics, Registered Dietitian
team.bio: Deepthi builds plans around what members already cook at home. She asks for a week of meal photographs before she writes anything, and she will not put a food on the sheet that is hard to buy in Patamata.
team.photoAlt: Deepthi Alluri at the nutrition desk
education: MSc Nutrition and Dietetics — Acharya Nagarjuna University

reviews.name: Harika Nallamothu
reviews.text: I joined the 7.30 AM women's batch in January. Sowmya kept me on dumbbells for five weeks before the barbell, which I did not like then and understand now. I deadlifted 50 kg last week.

reviews.name: Venkat Sai Kolli
reviews.text: The ₹3,900 quarterly plan was the amount billed, no extra joining fee. Ravi rewrote my squat programme after I told him about my old knee problem, and he checked the first two sessions himself.

reviews.name: Praveen Kumar M.
reviews.text: The 5.00 PM circuit finishes at 5.45 PM. I have never once been late back to the shop. Imran runs the clock properly and there is no waiting at any station.

reviews.name: Sridevi Ch.
reviews.text: The diet plan from Deepthi was practical and used food we already cook. The 6.30 PM Zumba class gets crowded though, around 30 people in the studio on Wednesdays.
reviews.ownerReply: Reply from Zoom Fitness: Thank you. We have added a second Wednesday Zumba slot at 9.00 AM and capped the evening class at 24 mats.

reviews.name: Anil Babu Devineni
reviews.text: I came in at 96 kg with a desk job. The 12-week program cost ₹11,500 and included the Saturday measurements. I finished at 85.4 kg and the sheet showed where the loss actually came from.

contactFaqs.question: Is the first session really free?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes. Walk in with shoes and a water bottle. A coach takes you around the floor and runs one full session with you.

contactFaqs.question: What does it cost to join?
contactFaqs.answer: Monthly is ₹1,450 with a ₹500 one-time joining fee. Quarterly is ₹3,900 and annual is ₹12,600, and both waive the joining fee.

contactFaqs.question: Is there a women-only batch?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes. The floor is reserved for the women's batch from 7.30 AM to 8.30 AM, Monday to Friday, and Sowmya coaches it.

contactFaqs.question: Can I freeze my membership?
contactFaqs.answer: Quarterly members get 15 freeze days and annual members get 45. Tell the desk before the break starts, not after.

contactFaqs.question: Do you have parking?
contactFaqs.answer: Two-wheelers park in the basement. Cars park on the service lane, which is easier after 6.00 PM.

contactFaqs.question: Is EMI available?
contactFaqs.answer: EMI is available on the annual plan through the card machine at the desk. Ask for the current bank list.

story: Zoom Fitness opened in 2017 with eleven machines, two racks and one rule: nobody trains without a coach watching the first four weeks.

Members started travelling in from Benz Circle and Poranki, so the studio took the floor above in 2020 and moved the group classes upstairs. That freed the barbells for people who wanted to train heavy without waiting behind a class.
The gym still works the same way. Your programme is written on paper, your numbers go on a card at the desk, and a coach reviews both every four weeks.

rules.title: Rack your plates
rules.text: Strip the bar and return plates to the tree before you leave the rack. The next batch starts on the hour.

rules.title: Wipe the bench
rules.text: Sanitiser and cloth rolls sit at four points on the floor. Use them on benches, handles and mats.

rules.title: Indoor shoes only
rules.text: Change into clean shoes at the entrance. Street shoes damage the turf and the studio floor.

rules.title: One set, one phone
rules.text: Filming your own set is fine. Keep the phone off the rack and out of other members' frames.

rules.title: Tell the coach about pain
rules.text: Report any pain during a lift the same session. The coach adjusts the load rather than removing the exercise.

rules.title: Book classes the night before
rules.text: Class slots are held until 9.00 PM the previous night, then opened to walk-ins.
